scope: new role hypotheses and replication resources; preserve R01–R22 and E01–E38, no new task acceptance

models.nearest_primary: Foster et al. 2021, Deep Adaptive Design https://proceedings.mlr.press/v139/foster21a.html (adjacent acquisition policy, not a recording-process model); Che et al. 2018 GRU-D https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-018-24271-9 (missingness-aware prediction, not identical task)
models.classification: original task separation, established logistic baseline; marked temporal point process is a proposed challenger
models.inputs: past observation timestamps/masks, no withheld values
models.workflow: rural transfer: flag that sparse observations are not evidence of physiologic stability; do not infer actual capability
models.training_signal: future recorded measurement events, not latent disease
models.failure: documentation policy shift or informative missingness; no causal interpretation
models.experiment: PhysioNet 2012 full A/B observation propensity pilot; then marked temporal point process versus discrete-time hazard, and joint model versus independent observation/value components at matched compute

models.nearest_primary: Assran et al. 2025 V-JEPA 2 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09985 (action-free pretraining and robot trajectory planning); Hafner et al. 2023 DreamerV3 https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.04104 (learned latent environment dynamics and imagined control)
models.classification: working non-healthcare prototypes; healthcare latent representation/operations hypothesis
models.inputs: past multivariate service trajectories, observed operational constraints; candidate actions only in validated simulator
models.output: latent future trajectory distribution and decoded observable uncertainty
models.workflow: regional capacity and retrieval planning; evaluate demand uncertainty and service discontinuities
models.training_signal: held-out observed future service states for passive prediction; simulator transitions for action-conditioned modelling
models.baseline: seasonal naive, VAR/state-space, calibrated discrete-event simulation
models.failure: good representation loss but incorrect occupancy/constraints; observational associations mistaken for effects
models.experiment: NHS quarterly KH03 and daily UEC separately; train latent predictor with fixed dimension, contrast masked reconstruction vs embedding prediction, hold out trusts/eras; action effects only in frozen synthetic simulator

models.classification: working learned design-network precedent; healthcare cost-sensitive adaptation
models.inputs: current available observations, remaining feasible experiments/measurement costs
models.output: next design or explicit stop; uncertainty and expected gain
models.workflow: regional diagnostic pathway or rare-disease research; distinguish observation selection from decisions about clinical treatment
models.training_signal: development-only simulated posterior information gain, observed masked-value loss where available
models.baseline: no acquisition, fixed panel, greedy conditional gain, exact small-domain Bayesian design
models.failure: high predicted gain at target shift; acquisition delay or access not represented
models.experiment: simulation with known outcomes and hypothetical costs, external temporal benchmark; full budget curve and net benefit; no causal real-care claim

models.role: R17/R16 constraint-aware optimiser with learned search assistance
models.nearest_primary: Gasse et al. 2019 Exact Combinatorial Optimization with Graph Convolutional Neural Networks https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.01629
models.classification: working learned branching precedent; rural scheduling adaptation
models.inputs: typed constraint graph and solver state
models.output: branching or warm-start proposal, not authoritative feasibility
models.workflow: rural specialist coverage and theatre allocation under hard staffing/credential rules
models.baseline: unmodified exact solver with identical time limit
models.failure: invalid solution or systematic exclusion; solver must independently certify constraints
models.experiment: held-out shortage regimes in authored simulator, optimality gap and feasible rate at equal wall time; hard constraints never overridden

models.role: R18/R21 evidence-preserving system failure and commitment hypothesis
models.nearest_primary: Bennett et al. MIMIC-IV on FHIR https://doi.org/10.1093/jamia/ocad002 (interoperability data, not learned failure attribution)
models.classification: original proposed typed evidence/pathway task; no demonstrated specialist or novelty claim
models.inputs: FHIR resource/event history plus versioned obligation definitions
models.output: candidate unmet or superseded commitments, temporal evidence IDs and abstention
models.workflow: regional cross-facility handover; accountable clinician ratifies any closure
models.training_signal: independent authored lifecycle constraints; synthetic event mutations; real FHIR demo only schema/provenance smoke
models.failure: missing records treated as evidence of closure; retrospective blame
models.experiment: synthetic lifecycle families then rights-cleared demo structure verification; separate evidence completeness from task fulfilment
